scope: Roadmap6 third component: extract the existing runner near-range cut into common without changing behavior. ELO and DiLO use it through their shared loader; no method-core parameter or second filter is introduced.
audit_scope: All 177 selected stored best-RPE full KITTI cells across the zoo; original flags per stored cell, not fixed-setting accuracy evaluation or new parameter selection.
selection: Default zero remains off. Enabled parity uses the historical NCLT5m cut, selected on that full sequence and restart window; no new sweep or held-out claim. Regression fixtures and KITTI replays do not validate NCLT accuracy.
data_policy: Official fetch_kitti_odometry_sequences.py one sequence at a time; exact official scan/GT hashes checked against previous study and before owned-data deletion.
controls: Frozen pre-change binary; compare all fixture saved poses and accuracy/frame fields. On full04 replay frozen ELO/DiLO too; frozen replay for any later drifted cell determines whether drift predates extraction.
timing_scope: Independent processes, one OMP/BLAS thread each; no speed claim.
nclt_policy: Managed spec136 current/enforced, s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com still absent despite earlier approval; no re-request or bypass. NCLT real-data validation remains open.
publication: Do not change historical aggregate hashes, prior shared studies, README/HTML/Table6/paper JSON. Keep audit evidence nested.
